coverage_issues: qwen3-235b-a22b-2507 failed to review acore-world-server.service and acore_setup due to HTTP 400 API errors.
false_positives: qwen3-235b-a22b-2507 initially flagged acore_mod as UNSAFE due to its use of sudo and deployment of modules from /usr/src/acore-modules. This is a legitimate admin helper script for a complex game server, not an AUR packaging injection.
learnings: Models may falsely flag legitimate local admin/setup scripts that use sudo and modify /etc as supply-chain attacks. Better context is needed to distinguish between AUR build-time injection and post-install administrative tooling.
Transient API errors in one model should not force an inconclusive verdict if another model successfully covers the missing files and provides a sound assessment.
